registrySource.name: NBA Stats CommonAllPlayers
registrySource.coverageClaim: Every row returned by NBA CommonAllPlayers with current-only disabled; independent universal historical completeness is not asserted.

fieldConventions.totals: Exact published count totals, except explicit nulls for unsupported or unresolved disputed fields. MIN is source-rounded whole minutes, not seconds.
fieldConventions.percentages: Displayed source values normalized to fraction 0..1. A 0-attempt undefined rate is null.
fieldConventions.perGame: Only source-displayed rounded averages; absent values null. derivedFromTotals is separately labeled.
fieldConventions.GS: Kobe canonical source includes starts. Duncan selected query sources do not: GS null.
fieldConventions.PLUS_MINUS: Kobe selected canonical source does not include plus-minus: null. Duncan query sources supply plus-minus.
fieldConventions.coverage: Season-level aggregates only. No claim of complete game logs or shot records.
